change_reason: After the Stage 1 review the six-stage sequence was agreed: Stage 2 combines both S2 contract fixes (full-grid thermal scenario and full-grid centering with limited spatial Ridge retraining); S1 100m/20m training is Stage 3; 200m/50m and 500m/100m robustness is Stage 4; temporal transfer is Stage 5; freeze/external evaluator is Stage 6. Model criteria and fixed parameters are unchanged.

global_rules.primary_metric: Pearson r² separately per case; keep signed Pearson r and separate R²
global_rules.tie_policy: truth/prediction ascending; equal values by lower segment_id

top10_definitions.per_section: k=ceil(0.1*n_section) per section; aggregate with sum(k) or macro; different from global

stage_2_s2_fixes.goal: Fix both S2 contracts: full-grid thermal scenario and full-grid centering; retrain limited spatial Ridge.
stage_2_s2_fixes.input: strict S2 train 2018-09-23 only; target 2022-07-01 features only; retrospective not used for tuning.
stage_2_s2_fixes.selection: No retrospective tuning. Report centered as contract fix, not proven improvement.

stage_3_s1_100m_20m.goal: Train/evaluate S1 candidates on the fixed 100 m block / 20 m buffer scheme.
stage_3_s1_100m_20m.selection: No automatic winner; retain S1A unless predeclared filter is met on later robustness schemes.
stage_3_s1_100m_20m.top10_rule: per-section k=ceil(0.1*n); global k also reported; ties lower segment_id

stage_4_s1_robustness.folds: same fixed masks per scheme; LOPO retained separately
stage_4_s1_robustness.goal: Check stability on 200 m / 50 m and 500 m / 100 m; do not select a scheme after seeing results.
stage_4_s1_robustness.metrics: same definitions and keys within each scheme
stage_4_s1_robustness.selection_filter: promising_S1 only if MAE<S1A, signed r>0, and Pearson r/top10 recall not worse than S1A on both larger schemes; then compare affine; max 2 S1 challengers
stage_4_s1_robustness.unsupported: record unsupported if blocks or train rows insufficient; do not shrink buffer to force a result

stage_5_temporal_transfer.audit_fact: train dt is common 3.783710 years; production dt 1.404517 (508) / 5.188227 (13) / 4 fallback
stage_5_temporal_transfer.goal: Test only fixed temporal interpretations of a selected S1 correction, without a new hyperparameter search.
stage_5_temporal_transfer.metrics: same OOF/block metrics plus production prediction shift, |pred-last|, above-last, above-nominal, fallback, segment 135
stage_5_temporal_transfer.rate_fit: Only if training horizons are unequal. Audit found common dt_train, so a separate rate-fit is not needed/identifiable in this cycle.
stage_5_temporal_transfer.selection: External evaluation is required to choose a time law; keep S1A reference if no basis.

stage_6_freeze_external.goal: Freeze and prepare one-shot external evaluation; no fit in evaluator.
stage_6_freeze_external.score_policy: Do not invent overall score; per-case Pearson r² primary plus separate diagnostics.
stage_6_freeze_external.truth_policy: truth separate; no fit; no overwrite; metrics per case and lower-tail/top10

unchanged_from_v1.s1_selection_filter: MAE<S1A, signed r>0, Pearson r/top10 not worse on 200m/50m and 500m/100m; max 2 challengers
